description: Finds the pictures in the AIKIZI Brain (aikizi.com/brain, the map of every public AIKIZI decode) that look and read most like one public decode: up to 21, closest first, each with title, style, a small preview image, its aikizi.com/decode link and a link that opens it in the Brain. Takes a decode id from search_styles or an aikizi.com/decode/<id> link. Read-only; no sign-in needed. Example: {"id": "bc2be49a-ef44-417e-9015-4923febd46ae"}.

id.description: A public decode id (UUID) or an https://aikizi.com/decode/<id> link

name: find_look_alikes
title: Find look-alikes in the AIKIZI Brain
